description.ncbi_summary: Predicted to enable calcium ion binding activity. Predicted to be involved in cell adhesion. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be integral component of membrane. Predicted to be integral component of plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Cadherins are calcium-dependent cell adhesion proteins. They preferentially interact with themselves in a homophilic manner in connecting cells; cadherins may thus contribute to the sorting of heterogeneous cell types (By similarity).
